subsystem.instructions: Which emulator subsystem most likely produced this frame divergence?

criteria.ppu_fetcher: pixels shifted or wrong within a line during mode 3
criteria.stat_irq: a raster split lands on the wrong line
criteria.window: window position or line counter wrong

applies:SKL-0002.instructions: Does skill SKL-0002 apply to this incident: would a repairer fixing it touch what the skill covers?

criteria.true: fires when: a write to NR10 (0xFF10) changes the channel 1 frequency sweep and the sweep steps at the wrong rate; paths: core/index.ts

emulator_part.instructions: Which part of the emulator is the most probable source of the pixels that differ from the hardware reference?

criteria.ppu_fetcher: the tile fetch and pixel pipeline put pixels at the wrong x inside a scanline
criteria.stat_irq: the LCD status interrupt fires on the wrong line, so a mid-frame register change lands early or late
criteria.oam_dma: the object attribute transfer leaves sprites absent or out of date
criteria.window: the window layer starts at the wrong place or its internal line count is off
criteria.timer: a divider or timer count drifts, so time-keyed state is off

mid_line.instructions: Does the divergence start mid-scanline rather than at x = 0?

criteria.true: the first differing pixel on a line is not at x = 0

severity.instructions: How severe is this divergence for a player of the game?
criteria: cosmetic: a few pixels differ, play unaffected
visible: a region or band of the frame is wrong
severe: most of the frame is wrong or game state is broken

same_shape_as:OBS-0001.instructions: Is this incident the same failure shape as observation OBS-0001?

criteria.true: A frame divergence in scene 0, line band 0, box 0,0–160,144 (7042 px) at counter 1 was refused at diff-scope after a repair that wrote no summary.
